title: Drift detection for SFTP connectors should be on by default
current_state: SFTP connectors fail silently when client schema changes; drift detection exists but is opt-in.
desired_outcome: Drift detection on by default for all SFTP connectors, with a configurable alert threshold.
evidence: Client A: unannounced column addition caused 3-day sync failure (de-identified)
Client B: column rename caused silent data loss for one batch (de-identified)
Client C: drift caught only because FDE was on-call (de-identified)
